comment: The rate, depth and darkening filter are recomputed only every few dozen samples rather than every sample (Haze.cpp:362), which is why a fast CV into RATE or DEPTH steps rather than glides. The dry path is multiplied by the reciprocal of the density setting and the wet path by that same figure clamped between a half and one and a half (Haze.cpp:469), so the density control changes drive without changing output level much.
